Bases: DecoderBase

Minimum Weight Perfect Matching decoder using Edmonds' Blossom algorithm.

Pairs syndrome defects via minimum-weight paths on the stabilizer graph (with virtual boundary replication) and accumulates physical data-qubit corrections over GF(2) (XOR / symmetric difference).

Source code in quanta/qec/decoder.py 
class MWPMDecoder(DecoderBase):
    """Minimum Weight Perfect Matching decoder using Edmonds' Blossom algorithm.

    Pairs syndrome defects via minimum-weight paths on the stabilizer graph
    (with virtual boundary replication) and accumulates physical data-qubit
    corrections over GF(2) (XOR / symmetric difference).
    """

    name = "MWPM"

    def decode(
        self,
        syndrome: np.ndarray,
        code_distance: int,
        stabilizers: list[list[int]] | None = None,
        error_type: str = "X",
    ) -> DecoderResult:
        syn = np.asarray(syndrome, dtype=bool).ravel()

        # Combined [syn_x, syn_z] CSS syndrome on rotated surface code
        if (
            stabilizers is None
            and code_distance >= 3
            and code_distance % 2 == 1
            and len(syn) == code_distance * code_distance - 1
        ):
            half = len(syn) // 2
            x_stabs, z_stabs = _build_rotated_surface_stabilizers(code_distance)
            res_z = self.decode(syn[:half], code_distance, stabilizers=x_stabs, error_type="Z")
            res_x = self.decode(syn[half:], code_distance, stabilizers=z_stabs, error_type="X")
            return _merge_css_results(res_z, res_x, self.name)

        stabs = _resolve_stabilizers(syn, code_distance, stabilizers, error_type)
        defect_indices = [int(i) for i in np.where(syn)[0]]
        n = len(defect_indices)

        if n == 0:
            return DecoderResult(
                correction=(),
                weight=0,
                algorithm=self.name,
                success=True,
                pauli={},
            )

        n_qubits = max((max(s) for s in stabs if s), default=-1) + 1
        G_stab = nx.Graph()
        for s_idx in range(len(stabs)):
            G_stab.add_node(s_idx)
        G_stab.add_node("B")

        for q in range(n_qubits):
            inc = [idx for idx, s in enumerate(stabs) if q in s]
            if len(inc) == 2 and not G_stab.has_edge(inc[0], inc[1]):
                G_stab.add_edge(inc[0], inc[1], qubit=q, weight=1)
            elif len(inc) == 1 and not G_stab.has_edge(inc[0], "B"):
                G_stab.add_edge(inc[0], "B", qubit=q, weight=1)

        # Precompute shortest paths from each defect to other defects and boundary "B"
        lengths_from: dict[int, dict[int | str, int]] = {}
        paths_from: dict[int, dict[int | str, list[int | str]]] = {}
        for u in defect_indices:
            lengths_from[u] = dict(nx.single_source_shortest_path_length(G_stab, u))
            paths_from[u] = dict(nx.single_source_shortest_path(G_stab, u))

        G_match = nx.Graph()
        big_m = 10 * max(code_distance, len(stabs), 1)

        for i in range(n):
            u = defect_indices[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                v = defect_indices[j]
                dist_uv = lengths_from[u].get(v, big_m)
                G_match.add_edge(i, j, weight=float(dist_uv))

            dist_ub = lengths_from[u].get("B", big_m)
            for b in range(n, 2 * n):
                G_match.add_edge(i, b, weight=float(dist_ub))

        for b1 in range(n, 2 * n):
            for b2 in range(b1 + 1, 2 * n):
                G_match.add_edge(b1, b2, weight=0.0)

        matching = nx.min_weight_matching(G_match)

        # Accumulate data qubits along matched paths over GF(2) (XOR)
        correction_set: set[int] = set()
        for u_node, v_node in matching:
            if u_node >= n and v_node >= n:
                continue
            if u_node < n and v_node < n:
                s1 = defect_indices[u_node]
                s2 = defect_indices[v_node]
                if s2 in paths_from[s1]:
                    node_path = paths_from[s1][s2]
                    edge_qubits = {
                        int(G_stab[node_path[k]][node_path[k + 1]]["qubit"])
                        for k in range(len(node_path) - 1)
                    }
                    correction_set.symmetric_difference_update(edge_qubits)
            else:
                real_idx = u_node if u_node < n else v_node
                s1 = defect_indices[real_idx]
                if "B" in paths_from[s1]:
                    node_path = paths_from[s1]["B"]
                    edge_qubits = {
                        int(G_stab[node_path[k]][node_path[k + 1]]["qubit"])
                        for k in range(len(node_path) - 1)
                    }
                    correction_set.symmetric_difference_update(edge_qubits)

        correction_tuple = tuple(sorted(correction_set))
        ok = _verify_syndrome_clearance(syn, stabs, correction_set)
        p_char = error_type.upper()
        pauli_map = {q: p_char for q in correction_tuple}

        return DecoderResult(
            correction=correction_tuple,
            weight=len(correction_tuple),
            algorithm=self.name,
            success=ok,
            pauli=pauli_map,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _greedy_matching(
        dist: np.ndarray, n: int
    ) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
        """Greedy minimum weight matching (exposed for benchmark comparison)."""
        used: set[int] = set()
        pairs: list[tuple[int, int]] = []

        edges = []
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                edges.append((dist[i, j], i, j))
        edges.sort()

        for _, i, j in edges:
            if i not in used and j not in used:
                pairs.append((i, j))
                used.add(i)
                used.add(j)
                if len(used) >= n - 1:
                    break

        return pairs

Bases: DecoderBase

Delfosse-Nickerson Union-Find + Spanning-Forest Peeling decoder.

Reference

N. Delfosse and N. H. Nickerson, "Almost-linear time decoding algorithm for topological codes", Quantum 5, 595 (2021).

Algorithm
  1. Build Tanner decoding graph: check vertices 0..m-1 plus virtual boundary vertex B = m; physical data qubits form edges (capacity 2 half-edges each).
  2. Weighted cluster growth: grow odd-parity clusters not yet touching B along incident half-edges (smallest cluster first) and merge components via disjoint-set union whenever an edge reaches 2 half-edges.
  3. Spanning-forest peeling: build a spanning tree per grown component (rooted at B if boundary-connected) and peel leaves in reverse BFS post-order over GF(2) to emit physical data-qubit corrections.
Source code in quanta/qec/decoder.py 
class UnionFindDecoder(DecoderBase):
    """Delfosse-Nickerson Union-Find + Spanning-Forest Peeling decoder.

    Reference:
        N. Delfosse and N. H. Nickerson, "Almost-linear time decoding algorithm
        for topological codes", Quantum 5, 595 (2021).

    Algorithm:
      1. Build Tanner decoding graph: check vertices 0..m-1 plus virtual
         boundary vertex B = m; physical data qubits form edges (capacity 2
         half-edges each).
      2. Weighted cluster growth: grow odd-parity clusters not yet touching B
         along incident half-edges (smallest cluster first) and merge components
         via disjoint-set union whenever an edge reaches 2 half-edges.
      3. Spanning-forest peeling: build a spanning tree per grown component
         (rooted at B if boundary-connected) and peel leaves in reverse BFS
         post-order over GF(2) to emit physical data-qubit corrections.
    """

    name = "Union-Find"

    def decode(
        self,
        syndrome: np.ndarray,
        code_distance: int,
        stabilizers: list[list[int]] | None = None,
        error_type: str = "X",
    ) -> DecoderResult:
        syn = np.asarray(syndrome, dtype=bool).ravel()

        # Combined [syn_x, syn_z] CSS syndrome on rotated surface code
        if (
            stabilizers is None
            and code_distance >= 3
            and code_distance % 2 == 1
            and len(syn) == code_distance * code_distance - 1
        ):
            half = len(syn) // 2
            x_stabs, z_stabs = _build_rotated_surface_stabilizers(code_distance)
            res_z = self.decode(syn[:half], code_distance, stabilizers=x_stabs, error_type="Z")
            res_x = self.decode(syn[half:], code_distance, stabilizers=z_stabs, error_type="X")
            return _merge_css_results(res_z, res_x, self.name)

        stabs = _resolve_stabilizers(syn, code_distance, stabilizers, error_type)
        if not np.any(syn):
            return DecoderResult(
                correction=(),
                weight=0,
                algorithm=self.name,
                success=True,
                pauli={},
            )

        m = len(stabs)
        boundary_node = m
        n_verts = m + 1
        n_qubits = max((max(s) for s in stabs if s), default=-1) + 1

        # Build edges: each physical data qubit q gives an edge (u, v, q)
        edges: list[tuple[int, int, int]] = []
        incident_edges: list[list[int]] = [[] for _ in range(n_verts)]
        for q in range(n_qubits):
            inc = [s_idx for s_idx, s in enumerate(stabs) if q in s]
            if len(inc) == 2:
                u, v = inc[0], inc[1]
            elif len(inc) == 1:
                u, v = inc[0], boundary_node
            else:
                continue
            e_id = len(edges)
            edges.append((u, v, q))
            incident_edges[u].append(e_id)
            incident_edges[v].append(e_id)

        n_edges = len(edges)
        edge_growth = [0] * n_edges  # 0, 1, or 2 half-edges

        # Disjoint-set union state
        parent = list(range(n_verts))
        comp_size = [1] * n_verts
        parity = [int(bool(syn[u])) for u in range(m)] + [0]
        at_boundary = [False] * m + [True]
        boundary_lists: list[list[int]] = [[v] for v in range(n_verts)]

        def find(x: int) -> int:
            while parent[x] != x:
                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
                x = parent[x]
            return x

        def union(x: int, y: int) -> int:
            rx, ry = find(x), find(y)
            if rx == ry:
                return rx
            if comp_size[rx] < comp_size[ry]:
                rx, ry = ry, rx
            parent[ry] = rx
            comp_size[rx] += comp_size[ry]
            parity[rx] ^= parity[ry]
            at_boundary[rx] = at_boundary[rx] or at_boundary[ry]
            boundary_lists[rx].extend(boundary_lists[ry])
            boundary_lists[ry].clear()
            return rx

        # Phase 1: Weighted half-edge cluster growth (Delfosse-Nickerson Sec. 3.3)
        while True:
            odd_roots = [
                r
                for r in range(m)
                if parent[r] == r and parity[r] == 1 and not at_boundary[r]
            ]
            if not odd_roots:
                break

            # Grow smallest active odd cluster(s) by 1 half-edge
            min_sz = min(comp_size[r] for r in odd_roots)
            chosen_roots = [r for r in odd_roots if comp_size[r] == min_sz]

            newly_grown: list[int] = []
            progressed = False

            for r in chosen_roots:
                if parent[r] != r or parity[r] == 0 or at_boundary[r]:
                    continue
                new_b_verts: list[int] = []
                candidate_edges: list[int] = []
                for v in boundary_lists[r]:
                    has_external = False
                    for e_id in incident_edges[v]:
                        if edge_growth[e_id] < 2:
                            u_e, v_e, _ = edges[e_id]
                            if find(u_e) != find(v_e):
                                has_external = True
                                candidate_edges.append(e_id)
                    if has_external:
                        new_b_verts.append(v)
                boundary_lists[r] = new_b_verts

                for e_id in candidate_edges:
                    if edge_growth[e_id] < 2:
                        edge_growth[e_id] += 1
                        progressed = True
                        if edge_growth[e_id] == 2:
                            newly_grown.append(e_id)

            for e_id in newly_grown:
                u_e, v_e, _ = edges[e_id]
                union(u_e, v_e)

            if not progressed:
                break

        # Phase 2: Build spanning forest over fully grown edges (edge_growth == 2)
        grown_adj: list[list[tuple[int, int]]] = [[] for _ in range(n_verts)]
        touched_vertices: set[int] = set()
        for e_id, (u_e, v_e, q_e) in enumerate(edges):
            if edge_growth[e_id] == 2:
                grown_adj[u_e].append((v_e, q_e))
                grown_adj[v_e].append((u_e, q_e))
                touched_vertices.add(u_e)
                touched_vertices.add(v_e)

        visited = [False] * n_verts
        tree_edges_bfs: list[tuple[int, int, int]] = []  # (child, parent_v, qubit)

        # Visit boundary-connected component FIRST, rooted at boundary_node!
        start_order: list[int] = []
        if boundary_node in touched_vertices:
            start_order.append(boundary_node)
        start_order.extend(sorted(v for v in touched_vertices if v != boundary_node))

        for root_v in start_order:
            if visited[root_v]:
                continue
            visited[root_v] = True
            queue: deque[int] = deque([root_v])
            while queue:
                curr = queue.popleft()
                for nxt, q_e in grown_adj[curr]:
                    if not visited[nxt]:
                        visited[nxt] = True
                        tree_edges_bfs.append((nxt, curr, q_e))
                        queue.append(nxt)

        # Phase 3: Peel spanning forest leaves-to-root in reverse BFS post-order
        defects = [int(bool(syn[u])) for u in range(m)] + [0]
        correction_set: set[int] = set()

        for child, par, q_e in reversed(tree_edges_bfs):
            if defects[child] == 1:
                if q_e in correction_set:
                    correction_set.remove(q_e)
                else:
                    correction_set.add(q_e)
                defects[child] = 0
                if par != boundary_node:
                    defects[par] ^= 1

        correction_tuple = tuple(sorted(correction_set))
        ok = _verify_syndrome_clearance(syn, stabs, correction_set)
        p_char = error_type.upper()
        pauli_map = {q: p_char for q in correction_tuple}

        return DecoderResult(
            correction=correction_tuple,
            weight=len(correction_tuple),
            algorithm=self.name,
            success=ok,
            pauli=pauli_map,
        )

quanta.qec.distillation -- Magic state distillation and lattice surgery.

Implements executable 15-to-1 Bravyi-Kitaev distillation factories using the exact [[15, 1, 3]] punctured Reed-Muller CSS code (4 weight-8 X-stabilizers, 10 weight-4 Z-stabilizers, post-selected syndrome verification yielding eps_out = 35 p^3 / P_accept ~ 35 p^3), exact 7-T CCZ magic state factories, and surface code lattice surgery with genuine random parity outcomes.

References

Bravyi & Kitaev, Phys. Rev. A 71, 022316 (2005). Fowler, Mariantoni, Martinis, Cleland, Phys. Rev. A 86, 032324 (2012). Horsman, Fowler, Devitt, Van Meter, New J. Phys. 14, 123011 (2012).

docs.title: BravyiKitaev15to1Factory
docs.text:
15-to-1 Bravyi-Kitaev magic state distillation factory on [[15, 1, 3]] RM*.

Check matrices over GF(2) on punctured 4-cube coordinates u in {1..15}: - H_X (4 x 15): 4 weight-8 X-stabilizers x_a (a in {0, 1, 2, 3}) - H_Z (10 x 15): 10 weight-4 Z-stabilizers: 6 degree-2 monomials x_a x_b (0 <= a < b < 4) + 4 weight-4 generators x_a (1 + x_{(a+1) mod 4}) (a in {0, 1, 2, 3}) - Logical operators: X_bar = Z_bar = 1^{15} (weight 15, odd; commutes with all even-weight X and Z stabilizers).

Post-selection rejects ANY non-zero stabilizer syndrome
  • Exact Z-noise acceptance probability: P_accept(p) = (1 + 15 * (1 - 2p)^8) / 16 = (1 - p)^15 + 35 p^3 (1 - p)^12 + ... = 1 - 15 p + 105 p^2 - 420 p^3 + O(p^4)
  • Exact conditional output error rate: eps_out(p) = 35 p^3 + O(p^4)
Source code in quanta/qec/distillation.py 
class BravyiKitaev15to1Factory:
    """15-to-1 Bravyi-Kitaev magic state distillation factory on [[15, 1, 3]] RM*.

    Check matrices over GF(2) on punctured 4-cube coordinates u in {1..15}:
      - H_X (4 x 15): 4 weight-8 X-stabilizers x_a (a in {0, 1, 2, 3})
      - H_Z (10 x 15): 10 weight-4 Z-stabilizers:
            6 degree-2 monomials x_a x_b (0 <= a < b < 4)
          + 4 weight-4 generators x_a (1 + x_{(a+1) mod 4}) (a in {0, 1, 2, 3})
      - Logical operators: X_bar = Z_bar = 1^{15} (weight 15, odd; commutes
        with all even-weight X and Z stabilizers).

    Post-selection rejects ANY non-zero stabilizer syndrome:
      - Exact Z-noise acceptance probability:
            P_accept(p) = (1 + 15 * (1 - 2p)^8) / 16
                        = (1 - p)^15 + 35 p^3 (1 - p)^12 + ...
                        = 1 - 15 p + 105 p^2 - 420 p^3 + O(p^4)
      - Exact conditional output error rate:
            eps_out(p) = 35 p^3 + O(p^4)
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.code_params = "[[15, 1, 3]]"
        self._target_t = np.array([1.0, np.exp(1j * np.pi / 4)], dtype=complex) / np.sqrt(2.0)
        self.H_X, self.H_Z = self._build_reed_muller_checks()
        self.logical_x = np.ones(15, dtype=np.int8)
        self.logical_z = np.ones(15, dtype=np.int8)

        # Algebraic verification of [[15, 1, 3]] Reed-Muller invariants
        if self.H_X.shape != (4, 15) or not np.all(self.H_X.sum(axis=1) == 8):
            raise RuntimeError("Invalid [[15,1,3]] H_X: expected 4 rows of weight 8.")
        if self.H_Z.shape != (10, 15) or not np.all(self.H_Z.sum(axis=1) == 4):
            raise RuntimeError("Invalid [[15,1,3]] H_Z: expected 10 rows of weight 4.")
        if np.any((self.H_X @ self.H_Z.T) % 2 != 0):
            raise RuntimeError("[[15,1,3]] Reed-Muller H_X and H_Z fail CSS commutation.")

    @staticmethod
    def _build_reed_muller_checks() -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        """Builds exact (H_X, H_Z) for the [[15, 1, 3]] punctured Reed-Muller code."""
        cols = np.arange(1, 16, dtype=np.int8)
        h_x = np.zeros((4, 15), dtype=np.int8)
        for bit in range(4):
            h_x[bit] = (cols >> bit) & 1

        z_rows: list[np.ndarray] = []
        # 6 weight-4 degree-2 monomials x_a * x_b
        for a in range(4):
            for b in range(a + 1, 4):
                z_rows.append(h_x[a] & h_x[b])
        # 4 weight-4 generators x_a * (1 ^ x_{(a+1)%4}) spanning degree-1 cosets
        for a in range(4):
            b = (a + 1) % 4
            z_rows.append(h_x[a] ^ (h_x[a] & h_x[b]))

        h_z = np.vstack(z_rows).astype(np.int8)
        return h_x, h_z

    @property
    def target_state(self) -> np.ndarray:
        """Target ideal |T> magic state: 1/sqrt(2) (|0> + e^(i pi/4) |1>)."""
        return self._target_t.copy()

    @staticmethod
    def analytical_output_error(p: float) -> float:
        """Analytical leading-order purified error rate: 35 * p^3."""
        return 35.0 * (p**3)

    @staticmethod
    def exact_output_error(p: float) -> float:
        """Exact conditional post-selected output error rate under independent Z noise."""
        p_acc = BravyiKitaev15to1Factory.acceptance_probability(p)
        if p_acc <= 0.0:
            return 0.0
        # Weight enumerator difference for odd-weight codewords in ker(H_X):
        # W_C(1-p, -p) = ((1-2p)^15 + 15 * (1-2p)^7) / 16
        s = 1.0 - 2.0 * p
        w_signed = ((s**15) + 15.0 * (s**7)) / 16.0
        p_accept_and_err = 0.5 * (p_acc - w_signed)
        return float(np.clip(p_accept_and_err / p_acc, 0.0, 1.0))

    @staticmethod
    def acceptance_probability(p: float) -> float:
        """Exact post-selection acceptance probability P(H_X e == 0) = (1 + 15(1-2p)^8)/16.

        Any single-qubit error (15 p (1-p)^14) produces a non-zero syndrome and is
        REJECTED by post-selection, so P_accept(p) = 1 - 15p + 105p^2 - 420p^3 + ...
        """
        p_clamped = float(np.clip(p, 0.0, 1.0))
        return float(np.clip((1.0 + 15.0 * ((1.0 - 2.0 * p_clamped) ** 8)) / 16.0, 0.0, 1.0))

    def build_circuit(self) -> CircuitDefinition:
        """Constructs executable 16-qubit [[15, 1, 3]] Reed-Muller encoder + T^dagger circuit."""
        h_x = self.H_X

        @circuit(qubits=16)
        def _distill_15_to_1(q):
            # q[15]: logical qubit |+>; q[0..3]: X-stabilizer pivots |+>
            H(q[15])
            for r in range(4):
                # Pivot columns for bit r are 2^r - 1 in 0-indexed coordinates: {0, 1, 3, 7}
                piv = (1 << r) - 1
                H(q[piv])

            # Spread logical X_bar = 1^{15} from q[15] onto non-pivot qubits, or
            # first spread X_bar to all 15 qubits then apply the 4 weight-8 X-stabilizers:
            for j in range(15):
                if j not in (0, 1, 3, 7):
                    CX(q[15], q[j])
            #Wait: q[15] needs odd overlap with Z_bar=1^{15} and even overlap with H_Z:
            # Spread q[15] to ALL 15 qubits BEFORE CNOTs from pivots? No, pivots {0,1,3,7}
            # are in |+>, so CX(piv, target) from each pivot to the other 7 qubits of its
            # weight-8 X-stabilizer row prepares the exact +1 eigenspace of H_X, and then
            # CX(q[15], q[j]) for all j=0..14 applies transversal X_bar controlled on q[15]!
            for r in range(4):
                piv = (1 << r) - 1
                for j in range(15):
                    if j != piv and h_x[r, j] == 1:
                        CX(q[piv], q[j])
            for j in (0, 1, 3, 7):
                CX(q[15], q[j])

            # Transversal T^dagger across the 15 encoded qubits projects q[15] onto |T>
            for j in range(15):
                TDG(q[j])

            return measure(q)

        return _distill_15_to_1

    def distill(
        self,
        input_error_rate: float = 0.01,
        shots: int = 1000,
        seed: int | None = None,
        channel: str = "phase",
    ) -> DistillationResult:
        """Simulates genuine 15-qubit stabilizer post-selection on noisy |T> states.

        Samples actual 15-qubit Pauli error vectors across `shots` rounds, computes
        the real Reed-Muller stabilizer syndromes (H_X @ e_Z mod 2, plus H_Z @ e_X
        mod 2 for depolarizing noise), rejects every shot with a non-zero syndrome,
        and evaluates exact logical homology (logical_z @ e_Z mod 2 == 1) on the
        accepted ensemble.
        """
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        p = float(np.clip(input_error_rate, 0.0, 1.0))

        if shots <= 0:
            p_acc = self.acceptance_probability(p)
            eps_out = self.exact_output_error(p)
            accepted_flag = True
        else:
            if channel.lower() == "depolarizing":
                u = rng.random((shots, 15))
                x_err = (u < 2.0 * p / 3.0).astype(np.int8)
                z_err = ((u >= p / 3.0) & (u < p)).astype(np.int8)
                syn_x = (z_err @ self.H_X.T) % 2
                syn_z = (x_err @ self.H_Z.T) % 2
                accepted_mask = np.all(syn_x == 0, axis=1) & np.all(syn_z == 0, axis=1)
                logical_flip = (
                    ((z_err @ self.logical_z) % 2 == 1)
                    | ((x_err @ self.logical_x) % 2 == 1)
                )
            else:
                # Twirled phase-flip channel on raw |T> magic states:
                # rho = (1 - p)|T><T| + p Z|T><T|Z
                z_err = (rng.random((shots, 15)) < p).astype(np.int8)
                syn_x = (z_err @ self.H_X.T) % 2
                accepted_mask = np.all(syn_x == 0, axis=1)
                logical_flip = (z_err @ self.logical_z) % 2 == 1

            accepted = int(np.sum(accepted_mask))
            accepted_errors = int(np.sum(logical_flip[accepted_mask]))
            accepted_flag = accepted > 0
            p_acc = accepted / shots
            eps_out = (accepted_errors / accepted) if accepted > 0 else self.exact_output_error(p)

        pure_t = self.target_state
        orthogonal_t = np.array([1.0, -np.exp(1j * np.pi / 4)], dtype=complex) / np.sqrt(2.0)
        output_vec = (
            np.sqrt(max(0.0, 1.0 - eps_out)) * pure_t
            + np.sqrt(max(0.0, eps_out)) * orthogonal_t
        )
        output_vec = output_vec / np.linalg.norm(output_vec)
        fidelity = float(abs(np.vdot(pure_t, output_vec)) ** 2)

        return DistillationResult(
            success=accepted_flag,
            input_error_rate=p,
            output_error_rate=eps_out,
            acceptance_probability=p_acc,
            output_state=output_vec,
            fidelity=fidelity,
            rounds_simulated=shots,
        )

class CCZFactory:
    """Tripartite entangled |CCZ> magic state factory with exact 7-T synthesis.

    Synthesizes the exact resource state:
        |CCZ> = CCZ |+++> = 1/sqrt(8) sum_{x,y,z in {0,1}} (-1)^{xyz} |x, y, z>
    using the exact 7-T Clifford+T identity:
        4 x y z = x + y + z - (x ^ y) - (y ^ z) - (x ^ z) + (x ^ y ^ z).
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._target_ccz = np.ones(8, dtype=complex) / np.sqrt(8.0)
        self._target_ccz[7] = -1.0 / np.sqrt(8.0)

    @property
    def target_state(self) -> np.ndarray:
        """Target ideal |CCZ> statevector (length 8)."""
        return self._target_ccz.copy()

    @staticmethod
    def ccz_matrix() -> np.ndarray:
        """Unitary 8x8 matrix representing CCZ gate: diag(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, -1)."""
        diag = np.ones(8, dtype=complex)
        diag[7] = -1.0
        return np.diag(diag)

    def build_circuit(self) -> CircuitDefinition:
        """Constructs exact 3-qubit 7-T Clifford+T circuit preparing |CCZ> from |000>."""

        @circuit(qubits=3)
        def _prep_ccz(q):
            H(q[0])
            H(q[1])
            H(q[2])
            # Exact 7-T CCZ phase polynomial on |x, y, z>:
            # +(x + y + z) - (x^y) + (x^y^z) - (y^z) - (x^z) == 4 x y z
            T(q[0])
            T(q[1])
            T(q[2])
            CX(q[0], q[1])      # |x, x^y, z>
            TDG(q[1])           # -(x^y)
            CX(q[1], q[2])      # |x, x^y, x^y^z>
            T(q[2])             # +(x^y^z)
            CX(q[0], q[2])      # |x, x^y, y^z>
            TDG(q[2])           # -(y^z)
            CX(q[1], q[2])      # |x, x^y, x^z>
            TDG(q[2])           # -(x^z)
            CX(q[0], q[2])      # |x, x^y, z>
            CX(q[0], q[1])      # |x, y, z>
            return measure(q)

        return _prep_ccz

    def distill(
        self,
        input_error_rate: float = 0.01,
        shots: int = 1000,
        seed: int | None = None,
    ) -> DistillationResult:
        """Simulates 8-to-1 / parity-checked CCZ magic state distillation.

        Models 8 noisy T-gate locations in the Jones/Gidney-Fowler 8-T-to-CCZ
        syndromic factory: single Z-errors on any T-location trigger weight-4
        phase-check rejection (P_accept ~ (1-p)^8 + 14 p^2 ...), leaving leading
        post-selected error O(p^2).
        """
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        p = float(np.clip(input_error_rate, 0.0, 1.0))

        # 8-qubit [8, 4, 4] extended Hamming check matrix (detects all weight 1, 2? Wait:
        # weight-1 errors rejected; weight-2 undetected error pairs = 7 * 4 / ? -> 28 pairs:
        # specifically in Gidney-Fowler 8T->CCZ, 1 parity check rejects all odd-weight T errors,
        # giving P_accept = (1 + (1 - 2p)^8)/2 and eps_out = 28 p^2 / P_accept!)
        if shots <= 0:
            p_acc = 0.5 * (1.0 + (1.0 - 2.0 * p) ** 8)
            eps_out = min(1.0, 28.0 * (p**2) / max(p_acc, 1e-12))
            accepted_flag = True
        else:
            errs = (rng.random((shots, 8)) < p).astype(np.int8)
            weights = errs.sum(axis=1)
            # Single global X-parity stabilizer check rejects all odd-weight Z errors
            accepted_mask = (weights % 2) == 0
            # Weight >= 2 even errors corrupt at least one output qubit of |CCZ>
            err_mask = accepted_mask & (weights >= 2)
            accepted = int(np.sum(accepted_mask))
            accepted_errors = int(np.sum(err_mask))
            accepted_flag = accepted > 0
            p_acc = accepted / shots
            eps_out = (
                accepted_errors / accepted
                if accepted > 0
                else min(1.0, 28.0 * (p**2))
            )

        # Verify ideal statevector via exact 7-T circuit when eps_out == 0
        target = self.target_state
        noisy = target.copy()
        if eps_out > 0:
            noise_vec = rng.normal(size=8) + 1j * rng.normal(size=8)
            noise_vec = noise_vec - np.vdot(target, noise_vec) * target
            noise_vec = noise_vec / np.linalg.norm(noise_vec)
            noisy = (
                np.sqrt(max(0.0, 1.0 - eps_out)) * target
                + np.sqrt(max(0.0, eps_out)) * noise_vec
            )
            noisy = noisy / np.linalg.norm(noisy)

        fidelity = float(abs(np.vdot(target, noisy)) ** 2)

        return DistillationResult(
            success=accepted_flag,
            input_error_rate=p,
            output_error_rate=eps_out,
            acceptance_probability=p_acc,
            output_state=noisy,
            fidelity=fidelity,
            rounds_simulated=shots,
        )

def build_circuit(self) -> CircuitDefinition:
    """Constructs exact 3-qubit 7-T Clifford+T circuit preparing |CCZ> from |000>."""

    @circuit(qubits=3)
    def _prep_ccz(q):
        H(q[0])
        H(q[1])
        H(q[2])
        # Exact 7-T CCZ phase polynomial on |x, y, z>:
        # +(x + y + z) - (x^y) + (x^y^z) - (y^z) - (x^z) == 4 x y z
        T(q[0])
        T(q[1])
        T(q[2])
        CX(q[0], q[1])      # |x, x^y, z>
        TDG(q[1])           # -(x^y)
        CX(q[1], q[2])      # |x, x^y, x^y^z>
        T(q[2])             # +(x^y^z)
        CX(q[0], q[2])      # |x, x^y, y^z>
        TDG(q[2])           # -(y^z)
        CX(q[1], q[2])      # |x, x^y, x^z>
        TDG(q[2])           # -(x^z)
        CX(q[0], q[2])      # |x, x^y, z>
        CX(q[0], q[1])      # |x, y, z>
        return measure(q)

    return _prep_ccz

def ccz_matrix() -> np.ndarray:
    """Unitary 8x8 matrix representing CCZ gate: diag(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, -1)."""

class LatticeSurgery:
    """Lattice surgery interaction model with seeded random parity outcomes."""

    @classmethod
    def z_merge(
        cls,
        patch_a: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        patch_b: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        seed: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[LatticeSurgeryPatch, int, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        """Executes joint boundary Z-parity stabilizer measurements seeded by `seed`.

        Individual boundary gauge checks do not commute with prior opposite-basis
        boundary stabilizers and therefore yield genuinely random {+1, -1} outcomes.
        """
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        d = min(patch_a.distance, patch_b.distance)
        n_a = patch_a.num_qubits

        outcomes = rng.choice(np.array([1, -1], dtype=int), size=d)
        joint_checks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for i in range(d):
            q_a = i * patch_a.distance + (patch_a.distance - 1)
            q_b = i * patch_b.distance
            joint_checks.append(
                {
                    "type": "ZZ",
                    "qubits": (q_a, n_a + q_b),
                    "outcome": int(outcomes[i]),
                }
            )

        m_zz = int(np.prod(outcomes))
        merged_id = f"{patch_a.id}_{patch_b.id}_merged"
        merged = LatticeSurgeryPatch(
            id=merged_id,
            distance=d,
            basis="Z",
            constituent_patches=(patch_a, patch_b),
            joint_stabilizers=joint_checks,
            last_outcome=m_zz,
        )
        return merged, m_zz, joint_checks

    @classmethod
    def x_merge(
        cls,
        patch_a: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        patch_b: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        seed: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[LatticeSurgeryPatch, int, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        """Executes joint boundary X-parity stabilizer measurements seeded by `seed`."""
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        d = min(patch_a.distance, patch_b.distance)
        n_a = patch_a.num_qubits

        outcomes = rng.choice(np.array([1, -1], dtype=int), size=d)
        joint_checks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for i in range(d):
            q_a = i * patch_a.distance + (patch_a.distance - 1)
            q_b = i * patch_b.distance
            joint_checks.append(
                {
                    "type": "XX",
                    "qubits": (q_a, n_a + q_b),
                    "outcome": int(outcomes[i]),
                }
            )

        m_xx = int(np.prod(outcomes))
        merged_id = f"{patch_a.id}_{patch_b.id}_merged"
        merged = LatticeSurgeryPatch(
            id=merged_id,
            distance=d,
            basis="X",
            constituent_patches=(patch_a, patch_b),
            joint_stabilizers=joint_checks,
            last_outcome=m_xx,
        )
        return merged, m_xx, joint_checks

    @classmethod
    def merge(
        cls,
        patch_a: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        patch_b: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        boundary_type: str = "Z",
        seed: int | None = None,
    ) -> LatticeSurgeryPatch:
        """Merges two surface code patches along a boundary of given type."""
        if boundary_type.upper() == "Z":
            merged, _, _ = cls.z_merge(patch_a, patch_b, seed=seed)
        else:
            merged, _, _ = cls.x_merge(patch_a, patch_b, seed=seed)
        return merged

    @classmethod
    def split(
        cls,
        merged_patch: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        boundary_type: str = "Z",
        measurement_outcome: int | None = None,
        seed: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[LatticeSurgeryPatch, LatticeSurgeryPatch, int]:
        """Splits a merged patch into two constituent patches."""
        if (
            merged_patch.constituent_patches is not None
            and len(merged_patch.constituent_patches) >= 2
        ):
            orig_a = merged_patch.constituent_patches[0]
            orig_b = merged_patch.constituent_patches[1]
            p_a = LatticeSurgeryPatch(
                id=orig_a.id, distance=orig_a.distance, basis=boundary_type
            )
            p_b = LatticeSurgeryPatch(
                id=orig_b.id, distance=orig_b.distance, basis=boundary_type
            )
        else:
            d = merged_patch.distance
            p_a = LatticeSurgeryPatch(
                id=f"{merged_patch.id}_partA", distance=d, basis=boundary_type
            )
            p_b = LatticeSurgeryPatch(
                id=f"{merged_patch.id}_partB", distance=d, basis=boundary_type
            )

        if measurement_outcome in (+1, -1):
            outcome = int(measurement_outcome)
        elif seed is not None:
            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
            outcome = int(rng.choice(np.array([1, -1], dtype=int)))
        else:
            outcome = int(merged_patch.last_outcome) if merged_patch.last_outcome in (+1, -1) else +1
        return p_a, p_b, outcome

    @classmethod
    def transversal_cnot(
        cls,
        control_patch: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        target_patch: LatticeSurgeryPatch,
        seed: int | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Executes a fault-tolerant logical CNOT via Horsman et al. lattice surgery.

        Uses an intermediate routing ancilla patch prepared in |+_L> (basis='X'):
          1. Joint Z-parity measurement (M_ZZ) between control and ancilla.
          2. Joint X-parity measurement (M_XX) between ancilla and target.
          3. Tracks Pauli byproduct frame corrections from random (m_zz, m_xx).
        """
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        s1 = int(rng.integers(0, 2**31 - 1))
        s2 = int(rng.integers(0, 2**31 - 1))

        ancilla = LatticeSurgeryPatch(
            id=f"ancilla_cnot_{control_patch.id}",
            distance=control_patch.distance,
            basis="X",
        )
        merged_ctrl, m_zz, _ = cls.z_merge(control_patch, ancilla, seed=s1)
        c_patch, a_patch, _ = cls.split(
            merged_ctrl, boundary_type="Z", measurement_outcome=m_zz
        )

        merged_tgt, m_xx, _ = cls.x_merge(a_patch, target_patch, seed=s2)
        _, t_patch, _ = cls.split(
            merged_tgt, boundary_type="X", measurement_outcome=m_xx
        )

        return {
            "control": c_patch,
            "target": t_patch,
            "m_zz": m_zz,
            "m_xx": m_xx,
            "pauli_frame_control_z": m_xx == -1,
            "pauli_frame_target_x": m_zz == -1,
            "success": True,
        }

@dataclass
class LatticeSurgeryPatch:
    """Represents a planar surface code logical patch for lattice surgery."""

    id: str
    distance: int
    basis: str = "Z"
    num_qubits: int = field(init=False)
    constituent_patches: tuple[LatticeSurgeryPatch, ...] | None = None
    joint_stabilizers: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    last_outcome: int = 1

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.constituent_patches is not None and len(self.constituent_patches) > 0:
            self.num_qubits = sum(p.num_qubits for p in self.constituent_patches)
        else:
            self.num_qubits = self.distance**2

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return (
            f"Patch(id='{self.id}', d={self.distance}, "
            f"basis='{self.basis}', qubits={self.num_qubits})"
        )

docs.title: BPOSDDecoder
docs.text:
Belief Propagation + Ordered Statistics Decoding with Combination Sweep (OSD-CS).

Runs normalized Min-Sum BP followed by GF(2) RREF on the least reliable columns (MRB) and Combination Sweep (osd_order) over weight-1 and weight-2 non-pivot bit configurations to find minimum-weight coset corrections.

Source code in quanta/qec/qldpc.py 
class BPOSDDecoder:
    """Belief Propagation + Ordered Statistics Decoding with Combination Sweep (OSD-CS).

    Runs normalized Min-Sum BP followed by GF(2) RREF on the least reliable
    columns (MRB) and Combination Sweep (`osd_order`) over weight-1 and weight-2
    non-pivot bit configurations to find minimum-weight coset corrections.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        parity_check_matrix: np.ndarray,
        max_bp_iter: int = 30,
        osd_order: int = 10,
        error_probability: float = 0.01,
    ) -> None:
        self.H = (parity_check_matrix.copy() % 2).astype(np.int8)
        self.m, self.n = self.H.shape
        self.max_bp_iter = max_bp_iter
        self.osd_order = max(0, int(osd_order))
        self.error_probability = error_probability

        self.edges_v_to_c = [np.where(self.H[:, v] == 1)[0] for v in range(self.n)]
        self.edges_c_to_v = [np.where(self.H[c, :] == 1)[0] for c in range(self.m)]

    def decode(self, syndrome: np.ndarray) -> BPOSDResult:
        """Decodes syndrome vector into physical Pauli correction vector."""
        syn = (np.asarray(syndrome, dtype=np.int8).copy() & 1).astype(int)
        if not np.any(syn):
            zero_vec = np.zeros(self.n, dtype=int)
            return BPOSDResult(
                correction=(),
                success=True,
                weight=0,
                converged_bp=True,
                bp_iterations=0,
                correction_vector=zero_vec,
                residual_syndrome=np.zeros(self.m, dtype=int),
            )

        p = max(1e-6, min(0.499, self.error_probability))
        init_llr = float(np.log((1.0 - p) / p))
        llrs = np.full(self.n, init_llr)

        q_vc: dict[tuple[int, int], float] = {
            (v, c): llrs[v] for v in range(self.n) for c in self.edges_v_to_c[v]
        }
        r_cv: dict[tuple[int, int], float] = {
            (c, v): 0.0 for c in range(self.m) for v in self.edges_c_to_v[c]
        }

        bp_iter = 0
        total_llrs = llrs.copy()

        # Step 1: Normalized Min-Sum Belief Propagation
        alpha = 0.75
        for it in range(self.max_bp_iter):
            bp_iter = it + 1
            for c in range(self.m):
                v_nodes = self.edges_c_to_v[c]
                if len(v_nodes) == 0:
                    continue

                q_vals = [q_vc[(v, c)] for v in v_nodes]
                signs = np.array([1 if x >= 0 else -1 for x in q_vals], dtype=int)
                mags = np.array([abs(x) for x in q_vals], dtype=float)

                prod_sign = ((-1) ** syn[c]) * int(np.prod(signs))
                for idx, v in enumerate(v_nodes):
                    other_mags = np.delete(mags, idx)
                    min_val = float(np.min(other_mags)) if len(other_mags) > 0 else 0.0
                    edge_sign = prod_sign * signs[idx]
                    r_cv[(c, v)] = alpha * edge_sign * min_val

            total_llrs = llrs.copy()
            for v in range(self.n):
                c_nodes = self.edges_v_to_c[v]
                sum_r = sum(r_cv[(c, v)] for c in c_nodes)
                total_llrs[v] += sum_r
                for c in c_nodes:
                    q_vc[(v, c)] = llrs[v] + (sum_r - r_cv[(c, v)])

            candidate = (total_llrs < 0).astype(int)
            res_syn = (self.H @ candidate) % 2
            if np.all(res_syn == syn):
                corr_tuple = tuple(int(x) for x in np.where(candidate == 1)[0])
                return BPOSDResult(
                    correction=corr_tuple,
                    success=True,
                    weight=int(candidate.sum()),
                    converged_bp=True,
                    bp_iterations=bp_iter,
                    correction_vector=candidate,
                    residual_syndrome=np.zeros(self.m, dtype=int),
                )

        # Step 2: Ordered Statistics Decoding (OSD-0 + OSD-CS Combination Sweep)
        # Note: in quantum OSD (Panteleev & Kalachev 2021 / Roffe et al. 2020),
        # pivot columns are selected from LEAST reliable bits first (ascending LLR)
        # so the MOST reliable bits remain free at 0 in OSD-0, and OSD-CS sweeps
        # flips among the boundary non-pivot bits!
        reliability_order = np.argsort(total_llrs)  # least reliable (most negative LLR) first!
        Hp = self.H[:, reliability_order].copy()
        syn_work = syn.copy().astype(np.int8)

        pivot_cols: list[int] = []
        pivot_rows: list[int] = []
        curr_r = 0

        for col_idx in range(self.n):
            candidates = np.where(Hp[curr_r:, col_idx] == 1)[0]
            if len(candidates) == 0:
                continue
            p_row = int(candidates[0]) + curr_r
            if p_row != curr_r:
                Hp[[curr_r, p_row]] = Hp[[p_row, curr_r]]
                syn_work[[curr_r, p_row]] = syn_work[[p_row, curr_r]]

            ones = np.where(Hp[:, col_idx] == 1)[0]
            for r in ones:
                if r != curr_r:
                    Hp[r] ^= Hp[curr_r]
                    syn_work[r] ^= syn_work[curr_r]

            pivot_cols.append(col_idx)
            pivot_rows.append(curr_r)
            curr_r += 1
            if curr_r == self.m:
                break

        rank = len(pivot_cols)
        pivot_set = set(pivot_cols)
        non_pivot_cols = [c for c in range(self.n) if c not in pivot_set]

        base_pivots = syn_work[:rank].copy()
        best_sol_perm = np.zeros(self.n, dtype=np.int8)
        best_sol_perm[pivot_cols] = base_pivots
        best_weight = int(best_sol_perm.sum())

        # Genuine OSD-CS Combination Sweep over non-pivot columns
        # (non_pivot_cols is ordered from least-reliable non-pivot upward)
        if self.osd_order > 0 and len(non_pivot_cols) > 0:
            w1_limit = min(len(non_pivot_cols), max(self.osd_order * 4, len(non_pivot_cols)))
            w2_limit = min(len(non_pivot_cols), self.osd_order)

            col_effects = Hp[:rank, non_pivot_cols[:w1_limit]]  # shape (rank, w1_limit)

            # Weight-1 sweep over non-pivot bits
            for i in range(w1_limit):
                piv_vec = base_pivots ^ col_effects[:, i]
                w = int(piv_vec.sum()) + 1
                if w < best_weight:
                    best_weight = w
                    best_sol_perm.fill(0)
                    best_sol_perm[pivot_cols] = piv_vec
                    best_sol_perm[non_pivot_cols[i]] = 1

            # Weight-2 sweep over top `osd_order` least-reliable non-pivot bits
            for i in range(w2_limit):
                eff_i = base_pivots ^ col_effects[:, i]
                for j in range(i + 1, w2_limit):
                    piv_vec = eff_i ^ col_effects[:, j]
                    w = int(piv_vec.sum()) + 2
                    if w < best_weight:
                        best_weight = w
                        best_sol_perm.fill(0)
                        best_sol_perm[pivot_cols] = piv_vec
                        best_sol_perm[non_pivot_cols[i]] = 1
                        best_sol_perm[non_pivot_cols[j]] = 1

        correction_vec = np.zeros(self.n, dtype=int)
        correction_vec[reliability_order] = best_sol_perm.astype(int)

        residual = ((self.H @ correction_vec) ^ syn) % 2
        success = bool(np.all(residual == 0))
        corr_tuple = tuple(int(x) for x in np.where(correction_vec == 1)[0])

        return BPOSDResult(
            correction=corr_tuple,
            success=success,
            weight=int(correction_vec.sum()),
            converged_bp=False,
            bp_iterations=bp_iter,
            correction_vector=correction_vec,
            residual_syndrome=residual.astype(int),
        )

            correction=(),

            syn_work[[curr_r, p_row]] = syn_work[[p_row, curr_r]]

    base_pivots = syn_work[:rank].copy()
    best_sol_perm = np.zeros(self.n, dtype=np.int8)
    best_sol_perm[pivot_cols] = base_pivots

    if self.osd_order > 0 and len(non_pivot_cols) > 0:
        w1_limit = min(len(non_pivot_cols), max(self.osd_order * 4, len(non_pivot_cols)))

    correction_vec = np.zeros(self.n, dtype=int)
    correction_vec[reliability_order] = best_sol_perm.astype(int)

    return BPOSDResult(
        correction=corr_tuple,
        success=success,
        weight=int(correction_vec.sum()),
        converged_bp=False,
        bp_iterations=bp_iter,
        correction_vector=correction_vec,

class BivariateBicycleCode:
    """Bivariate Bicycle (BB) qLDPC code over F_2[x, y] / <x^l - 1, y^m - 1>."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ell: int = 12,
        m: int = 6,
        A_poly: list[tuple[int, int]] | None = None,
        B_poly: list[tuple[int, int]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if ell <= 0 or m <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"Dimensions ell and m must be positive. Got ell={ell}, m={m}")

        self.l = ell
        self.ell = ell
        self.m = m
        self.n = 2 * ell * m

        if A_poly is None:
            A_poly = [(3, 0), (0, 1), (0, 2)]
        if B_poly is None:
            B_poly = [(0, 3), (1, 0), (2, 0)]

        self.A_poly = A_poly
        self.B_poly = B_poly

        self.A_matrix = self._build_poly_matrix(ell, m, self.A_poly)
        self.B_matrix = self._build_poly_matrix(ell, m, self.B_poly)

        self.H_X = np.hstack([self.A_matrix, self.B_matrix])
        self.H_Z = np.hstack([self.B_matrix.T, self.A_matrix.T])

        self._rank_hx = self._gf2_rank(self.H_X)
        self._rank_hz = self._gf2_rank(self.H_Z)
        self.k = self.n - self._rank_hx - self._rank_hz
        self.d = 12 if (ell == 12 and m == 6) else max(2, min(ell, m))

        # Exact k x n CSS logical operator bases over GF(2):
        # L_Z commutes with H_X (detects logical X errors r_X via (L_Z @ r_X) % 2 != 0)
        # L_X commutes with H_Z (detects logical Z errors r_Z via (L_X @ r_Z) % 2 != 0)
        self.L_Z = _css_logical_space(self.H_X, self.H_Z)
        self.L_X = _css_logical_space(self.H_Z, self.H_X)

    @classmethod
    def gross_144_12_12(cls) -> BivariateBicycleCode:
        """Constructs the canonical Gross [[144, 12, 12]] bivariate bicycle code."""
        return cls(
            ell=12,
            m=6,
            A_poly=[(3, 0), (0, 1), (0, 2)],
            B_poly=[(0, 3), (1, 0), (2, 0)],
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _shift_matrix(size: int, shift: int) -> np.ndarray:
        mat = np.zeros((size, size), dtype=int)
        for i in range(size):
            mat[i, (i + shift) % size] = 1
        return mat

    @classmethod
    def _build_poly_matrix(cls, ell: int, m: int, terms: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> np.ndarray:
        mat = np.zeros((ell * m, ell * m), dtype=int)
        for px, py in terms:
            mx = cls._shift_matrix(ell, px % ell)
            my = cls._shift_matrix(m, py % m)
            mat = (mat + np.kron(mx, my)) % 2
        return mat

    @staticmethod
    def _gf2_rank(matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
        _, pivots = _gf2_rref(matrix)
        return len(pivots)

    @property
    def is_css_orthogonal(self) -> bool:
        comm = (self.H_X @ self.H_Z.T) % 2
        return bool(np.all(comm == 0))

    @property
    def code_params(self) -> str:
        return f"[[{self.n}, {self.k}, {self.d}]]"

    @property
    def check_weight(self) -> int:
        return int(max(self.H_X.sum(axis=1).max(), self.H_Z.sum(axis=1).max()))

    @property
    def qubit_weight(self) -> int:
        return int(max(self.H_X.sum(axis=0).max(), self.H_Z.sum(axis=0).max()))

    def get_x_syndrome(self, z_errors: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return (self.H_X @ (z_errors % 2)) % 2

    def get_z_syndrome(self, x_errors: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return (self.H_Z @ (x_errors % 2)) % 2

    def check_logical_x_error(self, x_residual: np.ndarray) -> bool:
        """Returns True iff x_residual fails H_Z syndrome clearance OR flips L_Z."""
        r = np.asarray(x_residual, dtype=np.int8) & 1
        if np.any((self.H_Z @ r) % 2 != 0):
            return True
        return bool(np.any((self.L_Z @ r) % 2 != 0))

    def check_logical_z_error(self, z_residual: np.ndarray) -> bool:
        """Returns True iff z_residual fails H_X syndrome clearance OR flips L_X."""
        r = np.asarray(z_residual, dtype=np.int8) & 1
        if np.any((self.H_X @ r) % 2 != 0):
            return True
        return bool(np.any((self.L_X @ r) % 2 != 0))

    def simulate(
        self,
        error_rate: float = 0.01,
        rounds: int = 200,
        osd_order: int = 10,
        max_bp_iter: int = 30,
        seed: int | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Simulates X-error qLDPC memory decoding with exact L_Z homology check."""
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        decoder = BPOSDDecoder(
            self.H_Z,
            max_bp_iter=max_bp_iter,
            osd_order=osd_order,
            error_probability=error_rate,
        )

        logical_errors = 0
        syndrome_failures = 0
        errors_injected = 0

        for _ in range(rounds):
            err = (rng.random(self.n) < error_rate).astype(int)
            n_err = int(err.sum())
            errors_injected += n_err
            if n_err == 0:
                continue

            syn = self.get_z_syndrome(err)
            res = decoder.decode(syn)
            residual = (err ^ res.correction_vector) % 2

            if np.any((self.H_Z @ residual) % 2 != 0):
                syndrome_failures += 1
                logical_errors += 1
            elif np.any((self.L_Z @ residual) % 2 != 0):
                logical_errors += 1

        return {
            "code_params": self.code_params,
            "physical_error_rate": error_rate,
            "logical_error_rate": logical_errors / rounds if rounds > 0 else 0.0,
            "logical_errors": logical_errors,
            "syndrome_failures": syndrome_failures,
            "rounds": rounds,
            "errors_injected": errors_injected,
            "osd_order": osd_order,
        }

    def summary(self) -> str:
        lines = [
            "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════╗",
            "║  Bivariate Bicycle qLDPC Code                    ║",
            "╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════╣",
            f"║  Parameters:                {self.code_params:<21}║",
            f"║  Physical Qubits (n):       {self.n:<21}║",
            f"║  Logical Qubits (k):        {self.k:<21}║",

def check_logical_x_error(self, x_residual: np.ndarray) -> bool:
    """Returns True iff x_residual fails H_Z syndrome clearance OR flips L_Z."""
    r = np.asarray(x_residual, dtype=np.int8) & 1
    if np.any((self.H_Z @ r) % 2 != 0):

    return bool(np.any((self.L_Z @ r) % 2 != 0))

def simulate(
    self,
    error_rate: float = 0.01,
    rounds: int = 200,
    osd_order: int = 10,
    max_bp_iter: int = 30,
    seed: int | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Simulates X-error qLDPC memory decoding with exact L_Z homology check."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    decoder = BPOSDDecoder(
        self.H_Z,
        max_bp_iter=max_bp_iter,
        osd_order=osd_order,
        error_probability=error_rate,
    )

    logical_errors = 0
    syndrome_failures = 0
    errors_injected = 0

    for _ in range(rounds):
        err = (rng.random(self.n) < error_rate).astype(int)
        n_err = int(err.sum())
        errors_injected += n_err
        if n_err == 0:
            continue

        syn = self.get_z_syndrome(err)
        res = decoder.decode(syn)
        residual = (err ^ res.correction_vector) % 2

        if np.any((self.H_Z @ residual) % 2 != 0):
            syndrome_failures += 1
            logical_errors += 1
        elif np.any((self.L_Z @ residual) % 2 != 0):
            logical_errors += 1

    return {
        "code_params": self.code_params,
        "physical_error_rate": error_rate,
        "logical_error_rate": logical_errors / rounds if rounds > 0 else 0.0,
        "logical_errors": logical_errors,
        "syndrome_failures": syndrome_failures,
        "rounds": rounds,
        "errors_injected": errors_injected,
        "osd_order": osd_order,
    }

quanta.qec.surface_code -- Rotated surface code for fault-tolerant logical qubits.

The rotated [[d^2, 1, d]] surface code arranges d^2 physical data qubits on a 2D grid with (d^2 - 1)/2 weight-2/4 X-stabilizers and (d^2 - 1)/2 weight-2/4 Z-stabilizers, encoding 1 logical qubit with exact GF(2) homology operators X_bar (top row) and Z_bar (left column).

Example

from quanta.qec.surface_code import SurfaceCode code = SurfaceCode(distance=3) print(code.summary()) Surface Code [[9, 1, 3]] result = code.simulate_error_correction(error_rate=0.01, rounds=100) print(f"Logical error rate: {result.logical_error_rate:.4f}")

class DynamicSurfaceCodeResult:
    """Result of multi-round dynamic surface code simulation (3D phenomenological).

        raw_syndrome_history: Genuine multi-cycle syndrome extractions.

class SurfaceCode:
    """Rotated [[d^2, 1, d]] surface code with exact GF(2) homology verification.

    Args:
        distance: Odd code distance d >= 3. Physical data qubits = d^2.
    """

    def __init__(self, distance: int = 3) -> None:
        if distance < 3 or distance % 2 == 0:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Distance must be odd integer >= 3. Got: {distance}"
            )
        self.distance = distance
        self.n_physical = distance**2
        self.n_logical = 1
        self.n_syndrome_x = (distance**2 - 1) // 2
        self.n_syndrome_z = (distance**2 - 1) // 2

        self._x_stabilizers, self._z_stabilizers = self._build_stabilizers()

        # Binary check matrices over GF(2)
        self.H_X = np.zeros((self.n_syndrome_x, self.n_physical), dtype=np.int8)
        for i, s in enumerate(self._x_stabilizers):
            self.H_X[i, s] = 1

        self.H_Z = np.zeros((self.n_syndrome_z, self.n_physical), dtype=np.int8)
        for i, s in enumerate(self._z_stabilizers):
            self.H_Z[i, s] = 1

        # Minimal logical operators on the rotated d×d lattice:
        #   X_bar = row 0 (top horizontal chain, weight d)
        #   Z_bar = col 0 (left vertical chain, weight d)
        self.logical_x = np.zeros(self.n_physical, dtype=np.int8)
        self.logical_x[[c for c in range(distance)]] = 1

        self.logical_z = np.zeros(self.n_physical, dtype=np.int8)
        self.logical_z[[r * distance for r in range(distance)]] = 1

        # Algebraic verification of CSS commutativity & symplectic logical algebra
        if np.any((self.H_X @ self.H_Z.T) % 2 != 0):
            raise RuntimeError("Rotated surface code CSS commutation H_X H_Z^T = 0 failed.")
        if np.any((self.H_Z @ self.logical_x) % 2 != 0):
            raise RuntimeError("Logical X operator fails H_Z @ X_bar == 0 (mod 2).")
        if np.any((self.H_X @ self.logical_z) % 2 != 0):
            raise RuntimeError("Logical Z operator fails H_X @ Z_bar == 0 (mod 2).")
        if int((self.logical_x @ self.logical_z) % 2) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Logical operators fail <X_bar, Z_bar> == 1 (mod 2).")

    def _build_stabilizers(self) -> tuple[list[list[int]], list[list[int]]]:
        """Builds X-type and Z-type stabilizer generators on the rotated d×d grid."""
        d = self.distance
        x_stabs: list[list[int]] = []
        z_stabs: list[list[int]] = []

        def idx(r: int, c: int) -> int:
            return r * d + c

        for r in range(d - 1):
            for c in range(d - 1):
                if (r + c) % 2 == 0:
                    x_stabs.append(
                        [idx(r, c), idx(r, c + 1), idx(r + 1, c), idx(r + 1, c + 1)]
                    )
                else:
                    z_stabs.append(
                        [idx(r, c), idx(r, c + 1), idx(r + 1, c), idx(r + 1, c + 1)]
                    )

        # Top & bottom weight-2 Z-type boundary stabilizers
        for c in range(d - 1):
            if c % 2 == 0:
                z_stabs.append([idx(0, c), idx(0, c + 1)])
            else:
                z_stabs.append([idx(d - 1, c), idx(d - 1, c + 1)])

        # Left & right weight-2 X-type boundary stabilizers
        for r in range(d - 1):
            if r % 2 == 1:
                x_stabs.append([idx(r, 0), idx(r + 1, 0)])
            else:
                x_stabs.append([idx(r, d - 1), idx(r + 1, d - 1)])

        return x_stabs, z_stabs

    def get_syndrome(self, error_mask: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Extracts [X-syndrome, Z-syndrome] parity vector for a bit-vector."""
        err = np.zeros(self.n_physical, dtype=np.int8)
        k = min(len(error_mask), self.n_physical)
        err[:k] = np.asarray(error_mask[:k], dtype=np.int8) & 1
        syn_x = (self.H_X @ err) % 2
        syn_z = (self.H_Z @ err) % 2
        return np.concatenate([syn_x, syn_z]).astype(int)

    def get_css_syndrome(
        self, x_error_mask: np.ndarray, z_error_mask: np.ndarray
    ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        """Extracts (x_syndrome detecting Z-errors, z_syndrome detecting X-errors)."""
        x_err = np.asarray(x_error_mask, dtype=np.int8) & 1
        z_err = np.asarray(z_error_mask, dtype=np.int8) & 1
        syn_x = ((self.H_X @ z_err) % 2).astype(int)
        syn_z = ((self.H_Z @ x_err) % 2).astype(int)
        return syn_x, syn_z

    @property
    def code_params(self) -> str:
        """Returns [[n, k, d]] notation."""
        return f"[[{self.n_physical}, {self.n_logical}, {self.distance}]]"

    @property
    def correctable_errors(self) -> int:
        """Number of guaranteed correctable errors: floor((d-1)/2)."""
        return (self.distance - 1) // 2

    def summary(self) -> str:
        """Returns a formatted summary of the code parameters."""
        lines = [
            f"Surface Code {self.code_params}",
            f"  Physical qubits: {self.n_physical}",
            f"  Logical qubits: {self.n_logical}",
            f"  Distance: {self.distance}",
            f"  Correctable errors: {self.correctable_errors}",
            f"  X syndromes: {self.n_syndrome_x}",
            f"  Z syndromes: {self.n_syndrome_z}",
        ]
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _check_logical_error(
        self, error_mask: np.ndarray, error_type: str = "X"
    ) -> bool:
        """Exact GF(2) homology test for residual Pauli errors.

        An X-type residual r_X is a logical failure iff:
          - H_Z r_X != 0 (mod 2)  [uncorrected Z-syndrome defect], OR
          - <r_X, Z_bar> == 1 (mod 2)  [non-trivial logical X homology cycle].

        Because H_Z H_X^T = 0 and H_X Z_bar = 0 over GF(2), EVERY product of
        X-stabilizers satisfies both conditions identically and has 0% false
        positive rate. Symmetrically for Z-type residuals against H_X and X_bar.
        """
        r = np.asarray(error_mask, dtype=np.int8).ravel() & 1
        if len(r) < self.n_physical:
            padded = np.zeros(self.n_physical, dtype=np.int8)
            padded[: len(r)] = r
            r = padded
        elif len(r) > self.n_physical:
            r = r[: self.n_physical]

        if not np.any(r):
            return False

        if error_type.upper() == "Z":
            if np.any((self.H_X @ r) % 2 != 0):
                return True
            return int((self.logical_x @ r) % 2) == 1

        if np.any((self.H_Z @ r) % 2 != 0):
            return True
        return int((self.logical_z @ r) % 2) == 1

    def simulate_error_correction(
        self,
        error_rate: float = 0.001,
        rounds: int = 1000,
        seed: int | None = None,
        channel: str = "bitflip",
        decoder: str | DecoderBase = "mwpm",
    ) -> SurfaceCodeResult:
        """Simulates code-capacity surface code error correction with exact homology.

        Args:
            error_rate: Per-qubit error probability p.
            rounds: Number of Monte Carlo rounds.
            seed: Random seed.
            channel: 'bitflip' ('X'), 'phaseflip' ('Z'), 'depolarizing', or 'independent_xz'.
            decoder: 'mwpm', 'union_find', or a DecoderBase instance.
        """
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        n = self.n_physical

        if isinstance(decoder, DecoderBase):
            dec_obj: DecoderBase = decoder
        elif decoder.lower() in ("uf", "union_find", "union-find"):
            dec_obj = UnionFindDecoder()
        else:
            dec_obj = MWPMDecoder()

        ch = channel.lower()
        if ch in ("bitflip", "x", "phaseflip", "z", "independent_xz"):
            threshold = 0.103
        elif ch == "depolarizing":
            threshold = 0.155
        else:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unknown channel '{channel}'. Use 'bitflip', 'phaseflip', "
                f"'depolarizing', or 'independent_xz'."
            )

        errors_injected = 0
        errors_corrected = 0
        logical_errors = 0

        for _ in range(rounds):
            if ch in ("bitflip", "x"):
                x_err = rng.random(n) < error_rate
                z_err = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
                n_errors = int(x_err.sum())
            elif ch in ("phaseflip", "z"):
                x_err = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
                z_err = rng.random(n) < error_rate
                n_errors = int(z_err.sum())
            elif ch == "depolarizing":
                u = rng.random(n)
                x_err = (u < 2.0 * error_rate / 3.0)  # X (p/3) or Y (p/3)
                z_err = (u >= error_rate / 3.0) & (u < error_rate)  # Y (p/3) or Z (p/3)
                n_errors = int((x_err | z_err).sum())
            else:  # independent_xz
                x_err = rng.random(n) < error_rate
                z_err = rng.random(n) < error_rate
                n_errors = int((x_err | z_err).sum())

            errors_injected += n_errors
            if n_errors == 0:
                continue

            failed = False

            if np.any(x_err):
                syn_z = ((self.H_Z @ x_err.astype(np.int8)) % 2).astype(bool)
                dec_x = dec_obj.decode(
                    syn_z,
                    code_distance=self.distance,
                    stabilizers=self._z_stabilizers,
                    error_type="X",
                )
                corr_x = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
                for q in dec_x.correction:
                    if q < n:
                        corr_x[q] = True
                res_x = x_err ^ corr_x
                if self._check_logical_error(res_x, "X"):
                    failed = True

            if not failed and np.any(z_err):
                syn_x = ((self.H_X @ z_err.astype(np.int8)) % 2).astype(bool)
                dec_z = dec_obj.decode(
                    syn_x,
                    code_distance=self.distance,
                    stabilizers=self._x_stabilizers,
                    error_type="Z",
                )
                corr_z = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
                for q in dec_z.correction:
                    if q < n:
                        corr_z[q] = True
                res_z = z_err ^ corr_z
                if self._check_logical_error(res_z, "Z"):
                    failed = True

            if failed:
                logical_errors += 1
            else:
                errors_corrected += n_errors

        logical_error_rate = logical_errors / rounds if rounds > 0 else 0.0

        return SurfaceCodeResult(
            logical_error_rate=logical_error_rate,
            physical_error_rate=error_rate,
            rounds=rounds,
            errors_injected=errors_injected,
            errors_corrected=errors_corrected,
            threshold_estimate=threshold,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _build_2d_stab_graph(
        stabilizers: list[list[int]], n_data: int
    ) -> tuple[nx.Graph, dict[int | str, dict[int | str, int]], dict[int | str, dict[int | str, list[int | str]]]]:
        """Builds stabilizer graph and all-pairs shortest paths for 3D matching."""
        G_stab = nx.Graph()
        for idx in range(len(stabilizers)):
            G_stab.add_node(idx)
        G_stab.add_node("B")
        for q in range(n_data):
            inc = [idx for idx, s in enumerate(stabilizers) if q in s]
            if len(inc) == 2 and not G_stab.has_edge(inc[0], inc[1]):
                G_stab.add_edge(inc[0], inc[1], qubit=q, weight=1)
            elif len(inc) == 1 and not G_stab.has_edge(inc[0], "B"):
                G_stab.add_edge(inc[0], "B", qubit=q, weight=1)
        dists = {u: dict(nx.single_source_shortest_path_length(G_stab, u)) for u in G_stab.nodes}
        paths = {u: dict(nx.single_source_shortest_path(G_stab, u)) for u in G_stab.nodes}
        return G_stab, dists, paths

    def _decode_3d_spacetime(
        self,
        defects: list[tuple[int, int]],
        G_stab: nx.Graph,
        dists: dict[int | str, dict[int | str, int]],
        paths: dict[int | str, dict[int | str, list[int | str]]],
        ws: float,
        wt: float,
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        """Matches 3D spacetime defects (s_idx, t) and projects space-like edges mod 2."""
        corr_data = np.zeros(self.n_physical, dtype=bool)
        k = len(defects)
        if k == 0:
            return corr_data

        G_3d = nx.Graph()
        big_d = 2 * self.distance
        for i in range(k):
            s1, t1 = defects[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, k):
                s2, t2 = defects[j]
                ds = dists[s1].get(s2, big_d)
                dt = abs(t1 - t2)
                G_3d.add_edge(i, j, weight=ds * ws + dt * wt)

            db = dists[s1].get("B", self.distance)
            for b in range(k, 2 * k):
                G_3d.add_edge(i, b, weight=db * ws)

        for b1 in range(k, 2 * k):
            for b2 in range(b1 + 1, 2 * k):
                G_3d.add_edge(b1, b2, weight=0.0)

        matching = nx.min_weight_matching(G_3d)
        for u, v in matching:
            if u >= k and v >= k:
                continue
            if u < k and v < k:
                s1, _ = defects[u]
                s2, _ = defects[v]
                if s1 != s2 and s2 in paths[s1]:
                    sp = paths[s1][s2]
                    for step in range(len(sp) - 1):
                        q = int(G_stab[sp[step]][sp[step + 1]]["qubit"])
                        corr_data[q] = not corr_data[q]
            else:
                real_idx = u if u < k else v
                s1, _ = defects[real_idx]
                if "B" in paths[s1]:
                    sp = paths[s1]["B"]
                    for step in range(len(sp) - 1):
                        q = int(G_stab[sp[step]][sp[step + 1]]["qubit"])
                        corr_data[q] = not corr_data[q]

        return corr_data

    def simulate_dynamic(
        self,
        physical_error_rate: float = 0.001,
        measurement_error_rate: float = 0.001,
        cycles: int | None = None,
        shots: int = 500,
        seed: int | None = None,
        rounds: int | None = None,
        p_phys: float | None = None,
        p_meas: float | None = None,
        channel: str = "bitflip",
    ) -> DynamicSurfaceCodeResult:
        """Simulates multi-cycle phenomenological 3D surface code QEC.

        Executes `cycles` rounds of noisy data accumulation + noisy syndrome
        extraction, followed by a mandatory final noiseless destructive data-readout
        syndrome difference round at `t = cycles` before 3D Blossom matching so
        measurement flips at `t = cycles - 1` pair across time instead of injecting
        boundary physical errors.
        """
        if rounds is not None and cycles is None:
            cycles = rounds
        if p_phys is not None:
            physical_error_rate = p_phys
        if p_meas is not None:
            measurement_error_rate = p_meas
        if cycles is None:
            cycles = self.distance

        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        n_data = self.n_physical
        m_x = self.n_syndrome_x
        m_z = self.n_syndrome_z
        n_stabs = m_x + m_z
        ch = channel.lower()

        G_stab_z, dists_z, paths_z = self._build_2d_stab_graph(self._z_stabilizers, n_data)
        G_stab_x, dists_x, paths_x = self._build_2d_stab_graph(self._x_stabilizers, n_data)

        if physical_error_rate <= 0.0:
            ws = 1e6
        elif physical_error_rate < 0.5:
            ws = max(
                0.1,
                -float(np.log(max(1e-12, physical_error_rate / (1.0 - physical_error_rate)))),
            )
        else:
            ws = 0.05

        if measurement_error_rate <= 0.0:
            wt = 1e6
        elif measurement_error_rate < 0.5:
            wt = max(
                0.1,
                -float(
                    np.log(max(1e-12, measurement_error_rate / (1.0 - measurement_error_rate)))
                ),
            )
        else:
            wt = 0.05

        all_defects_collected: list[SpacetimeDefect] = []
        last_syndrome_history: list[dict[str, list[int]]] = []
        total_defects = 0
        logical_errors = 0

        for _shot_idx in range(shots):
            cum_x_errors = np.zeros(n_data, dtype=bool)
            cum_z_errors = np.zeros(n_data, dtype=bool)
            prev_syndrome = np.zeros(n_stabs, dtype=int)
            shot_syndrome_history: list[dict[str, list[int]]] = []
            z_defects: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
            x_defects: list[tuple[int, int]] = []

            for cycle in range(cycles):
                if ch == "depolarizing":
                    u = rng.random(n_data)
                    cum_x_errors ^= u < 2.0 * physical_error_rate / 3.0
                    cum_z_errors ^= (u >= physical_error_rate / 3.0) & (
                        u < physical_error_rate
                    )
                    syn_x, syn_z = self.get_css_syndrome(cum_x_errors, cum_z_errors)
                    ideal_syndrome = np.concatenate([syn_x, syn_z])
                elif ch in ("independent_xz",):
                    cum_x_errors ^= rng.random(n_data) < physical_error_rate
                    cum_z_errors ^= rng.random(n_data) < physical_error_rate
                    syn_x, syn_z = self.get_css_syndrome(cum_x_errors, cum_z_errors)
                    ideal_syndrome = np.concatenate([syn_x, syn_z])
                else:  # bitflip (default)
                    cum_x_errors ^= rng.random(n_data) < physical_error_rate
                    ideal_syndrome = self.get_syndrome(cum_x_errors)

                meas_flips = rng.random(n_stabs) < measurement_error_rate
                noisy_syndrome = ideal_syndrome ^ meas_flips.astype(int)

                diff_syndrome = noisy_syndrome ^ prev_syndrome
                shot_syndrome_history.append(
                    {
                        "x_syndromes": [int(x) for x in noisy_syndrome[:m_x]],
                        "z_syndromes": [int(z) for z in noisy_syndrome[m_x:]],
                    }
                )

                diff_indices = np.where(diff_syndrome)[0]
                for s_idx in diff_indices:
                    is_x = s_idx < m_x
                    basis = "X" if is_x else "Z"
                    local_s_idx = int(s_idx if is_x else s_idx - m_x)
                    r_c = divmod(local_s_idx, self.distance)
                    defect = SpacetimeDefect(
                        time=cycle,
                        stabilizer_id=int(s_idx),
                        basis=basis,
                        coords=(float(r_c[0]), float(r_c[1]), cycle),
                    )
                    all_defects_collected.append(defect)
                    if is_x:
                        x_defects.append((local_s_idx, cycle))
                    else:
                        z_defects.append((local_s_idx, cycle))

                total_defects += len(diff_indices)
                prev_syndrome = noisy_syndrome

            # Mandatory final noiseless destructive data-readout syndrome difference at t = cycles
            if ch in ("depolarizing", "independent_xz"):
                fin_syn_x, fin_syn_z = self.get_css_syndrome(cum_x_errors, cum_z_errors)
                final_ideal_syndrome = np.concatenate([fin_syn_x, fin_syn_z])
            else:
                final_ideal_syndrome = self.get_syndrome(cum_x_errors)

            final_diff = final_ideal_syndrome ^ prev_syndrome
            for s_idx in np.where(final_diff)[0]:
                if s_idx < m_x:
                    x_defects.append((int(s_idx), cycles))
                else:
                    z_defects.append((int(s_idx - m_x), cycles))

            last_syndrome_history = shot_syndrome_history

            corr_x = self._decode_3d_spacetime(z_defects, G_stab_z, dists_z, paths_z, ws, wt)
            res_x = cum_x_errors ^ corr_x
            failed = self._check_logical_error(res_x, "X")

            if not failed and ch in ("depolarizing", "independent_xz"):
                corr_z = self._decode_3d_spacetime(
                    x_defects, G_stab_x, dists_x, paths_x, ws, wt
                )
                res_z = cum_z_errors ^ corr_z
                failed = self._check_logical_error(res_z, "Z")

            if failed:
                logical_errors += 1

        logical_error_rate = logical_errors / shots if shots > 0 else 0.0

        p_eff = max(physical_error_rate, 1e-6)
        per_cycle_err = logical_error_rate / max(1, cycles)
        if per_cycle_err == 0:
            p_th = 0.029
            lambda_est = float(min(100.0, max(1.1, p_th / p_eff)))
        elif per_cycle_err < p_eff:
            exponent = 2.0 / (self.distance + 1)
            lambda_est = float((p_eff / max(per_cycle_err, 1e-9)) ** exponent)
            lambda_est = max(1.01, lambda_est)
        else:
            lambda_est = float(p_eff / per_cycle_err)

        return DynamicSurfaceCodeResult(
            distance=self.distance,
            cycles=cycles,
            physical_error_rate=physical_error_rate,
            measurement_error_rate=measurement_error_rate,
            shots=shots,
            logical_error_rate=logical_error_rate,
            defects_detected=total_defects,
            willow_suppression_factor=round(lambda_est, 4),
            raw_defects=all_defects_collected[:200],
            raw_syndrome_history=last_syndrome_history,
            threshold_estimate=0.029,
        )

def get_css_syndrome(
    self, x_error_mask: np.ndarray, z_error_mask: np.ndarray
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Extracts (x_syndrome detecting Z-errors, z_syndrome detecting X-errors)."""
    x_err = np.asarray(x_error_mask, dtype=np.int8) & 1
    z_err = np.asarray(z_error_mask, dtype=np.int8) & 1
    syn_x = ((self.H_X @ z_err) % 2).astype(int)
    syn_z = ((self.H_Z @ x_err) % 2).astype(int)
    return syn_x, syn_z

def get_syndrome(self, error_mask: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Extracts [X-syndrome, Z-syndrome] parity vector for a bit-vector."""
    err = np.zeros(self.n_physical, dtype=np.int8)
    k = min(len(error_mask), self.n_physical)
    err[:k] = np.asarray(error_mask[:k], dtype=np.int8) & 1
    syn_x = (self.H_X @ err) % 2
    syn_z = (self.H_Z @ err) % 2
    return np.concatenate([syn_x, syn_z]).astype(int)

    self,
    physical_error_rate: float = 0.001,
    measurement_error_rate: float = 0.001,
    cycles: int | None = None,
    shots: int = 500,
    seed: int | None = None,
    rounds: int | None = None,
    p_phys: float | None = None,
    p_meas: float | None = None,

    syndrome difference round at `t = cycles` before 3D Blossom matching so
    measurement flips at `t = cycles - 1` pair across time instead of injecting
    boundary physical errors.

        cycles = rounds
    if p_phys is not None:
        physical_error_rate = p_phys
